japanLng.name: Japan LNG import price (cif)
japanLng.definition: Liquefied natural gas, Japan: average import price, cif. Mostly long-term contracts indexed to crude oil with a lag of several months, so it is NOT the JKM spot price. The World Bank estimates the two most recent months in each edition.

source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (Pink Sheet), monthly editions June 2024 to October 2026 (2 Oct 2026). Each month is taken from the edition named in its 'edition' field: the latest edition that lists it among its three monthly columns. Later editions revise some values slightly, especially Japan LNG.
coverageNote: Starts March 2024: the January and February 2024 values could not be retrieved from the editions available to the build agent. Monthly JKM averages are published by S&P Global Platts under licence and are not reproduced; the Japan import price is the free official proxy, and JKM spot is shown as reported snapshots.

monthly.hhNote: January 2026 Henry Hub from the World Bank series as republished by YCharts (7.583); the April 2026 Pink Sheet's Q1-2026 average (4.75) equals the mean of 7.58, 3.61 and 3.05. EIA's own monthly average is $7.72 (Winter Storm Fern, record daily $30.72 on 23 Jan).
